default.scope: general application including India-tagged, raw, OCR, manual or unknown provenance

combined.scope: explicit opt-in screened curated structured OFF research only; not automatically eligible based on text format alone

fine_tuning: deferred for prototype; original model weights unchanged
limitations: OFF labels not independently verified; near duplicates possible.
Stratified curated holdout; standardized estimates target screened curated groups, not retail prevalence.
Only 80 recorded NOVA 2 examples; rare-class estimates uncertain.
Structured input only; no fresh India or OCR validation.
Acceptance criteria are engineering choices; no tuning on holdout.
implementation_notes: Use unrounded logits and exact label order. No adjustments to general app predictions.
Do not expose research mode as validated for India or OCR.
Keep recorded OFF labels separate from model predictions.
Do not use comparison-cleaned ingredient text as classifier input.
Validate OCR and require user review; no confidence-only acceptance.
This file documents policy; backend must implement and test it.
